title: Largest Combination With Bitwise AND Greater Than Zero
summary: Calculate the bitwise AND for every combination of elements in the given array of positive integers.
statement: Calculate the bitwise AND for every combination of elements in the given array of positive integers. Return the count of the largest combination where the bitwise AND is greater than zero.
constraints: Choose a nonempty subsequence of candidate values.
Its bitwise AND is positive exactly when all selected values share at least one set bit.
Return the largest possible number of selected elements.
reference_solution:
def largest_positive_and_combination(candidates):
    return max(sum(value>>bit&1 for value in candidates) for bit in range(max(candidates).bit_length()))
hints: A positive AND needs at least one bit that is set in every chosen number.
For each bit position, count candidates containing that bit.
Return the maximum count over all relevant bit positions.
Any valid group contributes to one shared bit’s count, and choosing all values counted at one bit constructs a valid group of that size.
